changelog: New Series Rating Graph page for TV series.
Advanced search with actor search, media filters, and sorting options.
Improved image caching for faster and sharper page loading.
Enhanced video player with smarter watch history and episode resume.
Multiple UI, animation, and navigation improvements.

features.title: What's New
items: Added the new Series Rating Graph page.
Advanced search with Movies, TV Shows, Actors, and new Sort By options.
Keyboard shortcuts for faster Sort By navigation.
Actor cards now open a search page for the selected actor.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Improved image caching to reduce blurry images while pages load.
Enhanced video player and watch history with automatic season and episode resume.
Play and More Info buttons now work directly from the Home Hero Banner.
Improved Scroll to Top behavior and added a quick scroll button on detail pages.
Updated My List icon with a cleaner design.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed duplicate episode animations while switching seasons.
Added a loading indicator during episode loading.
Fixed multiple UI, layout, and navigation issues.
